# FS Ai Agency website integrations

> @franchiseai/website-integrations 0.1.0: headless qualification for React/Astro. The website owns all presentation.

Start with getting started and the contract. Use the demo until a published live configuration is supplied. Preserve server decisions and optional consent. Never expose application credentials.
